topic: Moving UK data from staging to production
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on migrating specific Universal Key (UK) data for a Mall location, involving 12 sensors. The goal was to replicate the staging environment setup onto production starting from October 20th. [p1] noted that they had accidentally failed to enable the necessary components in production, while the staging environment was confirmed to be working correctly. [me] subsequently completed the migration/update process.
decisions: UK data for Mall (7880) will be moved from staging to production.
action_items: Check the migrated data in production.
